title: fix(metadata-core): the artifact forward conversion walks every packages[].manifest body of an option-B artifact (ADR-0130 D4)
body:
Fixes #23027
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Two halves, one policy. Both use the one ADR-0087 conversion function, under one window.

**1. `@objectstack/metadata-core`, the conversion's reach.** `applyArtifactForwardConversions` (`artifact-forward-conversion.ts`) ran the conversion over the definition's own collections only. A multi-package artifact (ADR-0130 D4, option B) carries its collections in `packages[i].manifest`, and the strict parse gates each body. Now ONE walk runs over every root: the definition first, then each body. It is the same `applyConversions` call, with the same registry, the same `includeRetired` and the same `excludeConversionIds`. There is no second walk and no entry list of its own. Copy-on-write holds at both levels. A malformed `packages` or entry comes back as given: this never gates, and `resolveArtifactPackageOrder` stays the refusal. A body's notices are located from the root: `path`, and the one place `message` quotes it, read `packages[1].manifest.dashboards[0].refreshIntervalSeconds`.

**2. `@objectstack/runtime`, converting once at load.** The runtime read the bundle raw before any conversion. On `os dev -a` and `os start` the first reader to refuse was `createStandaloneStack`, through `resolveArtifactCollections` and `resolveArtifactPackageOrder`. `loadArtifactBundle` now calls `convertArtifactAtLoad` once on the loaded bundle, before `mergeRuntimeModule` and before any reader. Measured, every boot-path reader goes through it: `createStandaloneStack`'s surfaced stack, `AppPlugin`'s `collections` getter, `AppPlugin.init`'s `packages[]` branch (and from there the `manifest` service), `mergeRuntimeModule` and `os verify`'s loader. One reader reads the FILE by another path, `readConfigDeclaredDefault` in `resolve-project-database.ts`, and it now calls the same function on what it read. That is one function at each of the boot's two disk reads; no reader converts a bundle it was handed (option C, refused). `MetadataPlugin`'s own conversion of the same file stays and is idempotent; the idempotence is pinned once. The only `app-plugin.ts` change is the one comment sentence that said package bodies were what "no conversion reaches".

`convertArtifactAtLoad` is a module export, not a package export. `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` and `packages/metadata-core/src/index.ts` are unchanged, and `dist/index.d.ts` carries no such name, so no exported member changes (`Clause-②: no`, re-checked on the real diff).

## Which window governs a body: the artifact's (measured; accepted by the seat)

Measured on `os build` of `examples/app-multi-package`: the artifact's own `manifest` is its LAST package's, and each body carries its own `engines.protocol`. The window is decided once from the artifact's own `engines.protocol`, and a body's own range is not read. Why:

- One `os build` serializes every body (ADR-0130 D1).
- The artifact-boot handshake judges the artifact's own `manifest`.
- A per-body window would split the two copies of one definition that an additive artifact carries.

Both directions are pinned.

## The public door, before and after

| | BASE `0ede0f8ab3` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `os dev -a optionb.json --fresh` (two-package `os build` output, `refreshInterval: 300` in a body) | exits at boot, health `000`: "`packages[1]` is not a package entry (ADR-0130 D4): manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval…" | health `200`; `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/crm_overview` and the list serve `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, `valid: true`, `_packageId: com.example.multi.core` |
| `os start -a optionb-multi.json` (both bodies carry the key, 300 and 120) | not measured on BASE; it composes through the same `createStandaloneStack` reader | health `200`; both are served converted, each under its own package |
| boot log | (no boot) | ONE line per conversion: "converted 2 site(s) forward via ADR-0087 conversion 'dashboard-refresh-interval-to-refresh-interval-seconds' (first at packages[0].manifest.dashboards[0].refreshIntervalSeconds)". The loader converts silently, the metadata door converts the raw file and prints, and `AppPlugin` finds nothing left to convert. |
| definition-collection CONTROL (no `packages[]`) | health `200`, served `300` valid | unchanged: health `200`, item and list `300` valid |

The database resolver, measured at the door. Without `--fresh`, take an option-B artifact whose body declares its default datasource (`datasourceMapping` `default: true` and a sqlite `datasources` entry) and still carries `refreshInterval`. With only the loader converting, it booted against the unified default database, because the resolver's own read refused the body and declined. The same artifact with the canonical key opened the declared `crm.db`. After the resolver called the loader's function, both open `crm.db`. This is why the resolver is routed: converting at load alone would have turned a loud refusal into a silent wrong-database boot.

Config boot (`composeStacks`) of the same shape: `os dev` exits before the server starts, at `defineStack`, with the tombstone prescription. `composeStacks` takes only `defineStack` inputs, and that is the authoring funnel, by design. No fix is needed.

## Tests, at the final head

Final head `20a5c41cfb`. All of it went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, and the VERDICT lines were read.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `6a01653b53`: 361 files passed; 5898 tests passed, 19 skipped. The one later commit types a literal in the new test file. That file re-ran at `20a5c41cfb`: 6/6.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` at `20a5c41cfb`: exit 0, "check:test-typecheck: OK … 27 file(s) / 190 error(s) / 68 pinned signature(s) held". At `6a01653b53` this was the CI red: the new test file had one TS2345 (an untyped union literal) in a file the ledger does not cover. Fixed in `20a5c41cfb`.
- The CI lane `Type Check · workspace`, reproduced locally as a pull_request event at `20a5c41cfb` (the step's own selector, `--concurrency=2` added locally): 65 affected packages, "Tasks: 130 successful, 130 total". On GitHub at `20a5c41cfb`, `Type Check · workspace` and `TypeScript Type Check` both read success.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core test`: 18 files, 681 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run`: 60 files, 879 tests passed. Both typechecks exit 0.
- New `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-option-b-forward-conversion.test.ts` (6 tests, real `createStandaloneStack` plus kernel boot, read through `getMetaItems` / `getMetaItem` as the HTTP door does):
  - the loader hands back the converted body, and a second conversion on its output returns the same reference with no notices (the idempotence pin);
  - the subject: `packages[0].manifest.dashboards[0].refreshInterval: 300` is listed and served as `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, valid, under the orders package;
  - multi-package: per body, each under its own package;
  - CONTROL: a definition-collection artifact is served unchanged;
  - WINDOW SHUT: still refused at the first reader, as `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` / `422`, naming `packages[0]` and `manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval`;
  - the database resolver resolves the body's declared default with the key retired and with it canonical.
- From the first half (unchanged since): `artifact-forward-conversion-package-body.test.ts` (metadata-core, 142 tests, including all 66 retired step-18 entries over a body, both directions) and `plugin-artifact-forward-conversion-package-body.test.ts` (the metadata door, 5 tests).
- Lint, narrowed to the 7 touched TS files, with three proofs. Population: `eslint --print-config` gives 6/5/5/6/6/6/5 rules in effect. Count: `--format json` reports 7 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Invariance: every `parserOptions` is `{ ecmaVersion, sourceType }` with no `project`, so there is no type-aware linting. `pnpm lint` is CI's to run.

## Ablations

Every leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. The direction was predicted before each run. Each restore was proven by blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- **The loader's call dropped** (`bundle = convertArtifactAtLoad(bundle)` became `void convertArtifactAtLoad`; blob `e49e71c00328` → `b2afed453050`). The runtime door file went red: the loader leg failed, and the subject and multi-package suites failed in `beforeAll` with the public door's own refusal, "Release artifact `packages[0]` is not a package entry (ADR-0130 D4): manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval…", which skipped their 2 tests. The CONTROL, window-shut and resolver legs stayed green, as did all of `app-plugin-converted-collections.test.ts` (Tests 1 failed, 11 passed, 2 skipped, out of 14). The metadata-core pins stayed green: 324 passed out of 324.
- **The resolver's routing dropped** (blob `a970de19be5c` → `41d80e491454`). Only the resolver leg went red: "expected [ 'unified-default', … ] to deeply equal [ 'config-datasource', … ]". The other 5 stayed green.
- First half (reported before; unchanged code). Dropping the body root in metadata-core gave 72 red and 252 green out of 324: 7 body pins and 65 step-18 before-legs. The metadata door through `dist/` gave 3 red and 27 green out of 30, with a rebuild and `ablation-dist-preflight` on both legs (`--absent` on the restore).

## Gates

`dispatch-gates --commands` on the real diff at `20a5c41cfb` (8 paths, merge base `df7a13792`) gives 65 commands, a superset of the lead list's 64. All 65 exit 0 at `20a5c41cfb`. `dispatch-gates --ran` reads "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". New since the first half: `check:swallow-census-controls` (exit 0). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` measured on the first run this time (full build), with exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `detectUnboundFormViewPredicateRoots` (`form-predicate-root-policy.ts`) reads only the definition's own `views`, so the bare-root form-predicate notice does not see an option-B body's views. It was read, not measured at a door, and it stays a note.
- `origin/main` was merged once before the gates (`6a01653b53`). It moved by two more commits during the gate run (`6a6a4d3e9c`); the derivation names `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` and `measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` as changed there. CI reads the merge ref.
